description: This Java source file defines the SubscriptionEventMappingStrategies class, which provides mapping strategies (from signal types to JsonifiableMapper objects) for various SubscriptionEvent types in the Ditto protocol adapter. It sets up a static map associating each subscription event type with a corresponding mapper lambda, handling different event types like SubscriptionCreated, SubscriptionComplete, SubscriptionFailed, and SubscriptionHasNextPage.
